items.title: Attention Sees, MLP Refuses: Tracing the Attention-to-MLP Safety Pathway in LLMs
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.13078v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreaks and can over-refuse benign requests. Understanding these failures requires distinguishing harmfulness recognition from the computation that writes refusal. We reframe this as a pathway question and make it measurable on residual-stream updates in decoder-only Transformers, separating the harmfulness information a module update exposes from the change it produces in readable refusal evidence. Across 18 Base-Instruct pairs spanning Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, harmfulness is decoded more readily from attention updates, particularly in early layers, whereas MLP updates contribute more strongly to harm-selective refusal writing in aligned models. Post-training strengthens MLP refusal writing in all 18 pairs without systematically improving harmfulness decodability, while positive MLP writing becomes more concentrated in deeper layers after post-training. items.reason_zh: 揭示LLM安全机制中注意力识别危害与MLP拒绝生成的分离路径，为理解越狱与过度拒绝提供可解释性视角。
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注安全对齐后的大语言模型仍易受越狱攻击且会过度拒绝良性请求的问题，提出将危害识别与拒绝生成的计算过程区分开来，并重新表述为一条可测量的通路问题。作者在仅解码器 Transformer 的残差流更新上追踪从注意力到 MLP 的安全通路，发现注意力机制能够识别有害内容，但 MLP 层可能拒绝执行拒绝写入，从而解释越狱与过度拒绝的机制。该工作为理解模型内部安全计算提供了可解释性工具，并可能指导更鲁棒的安全对齐策略。
items.title_zh: 注意力看见，MLP拒绝：追踪LLM中从注意力到MLP的安全通路

items.title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.12842v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. items.reason_zh: 挑战神经网络缺乏模块化的传统观点，提出嵌套模块化层级，发现网络比单个神经元所显示的更具模块性，对可解释性研究有启发。
items.summary_zh: 论文挑战神经网络缺乏模块化组织的普遍看法。神经网络常发展出单个神经元参与多个不同功能的表征，导致人们认为其缺乏模块化。作者引入一个形式化嵌套的模块化层级：单元级要求不同计算占据不相交单元，并在此基础上定义更高层级。通过该框架分析发现，神经网络实际比单个神经元所显示的更具模块性，为理解网络内部组织提供了新视角。

items.title: One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.12879v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass. We propose Seq-Drifting, a framework that applies drifting to sequences of continuous token representations and directly learns a map from Gaussian noise to text. Unlike existing DLMs that derive the supervision at each position directly from the observed token in a training sequence, Seq-Drifting builds a drift field whose position-wise targets adapt to the current generated context. At each position, attraction guides each output toward a set of contextually plausible token representations, while repulsion discourages collapse across samples and repetition within sequences. items.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型虽能并行生成token，但仍需多步采样才能产出高质量文本。论文探究模型能否在单次前向传播中生成完整序列，提出Seq-Drifting框架，将drifting方法应用于连续token表征序列。该方法试图让模型学会一步生成整段文本，从而突破扩散语言模型多步采样的效率瓶颈。若可行，将显著降低文本生成的推理延迟与计算成本，对扩散式语言建模的架构设计具有探索价值。

items.title: Mitigating Capability Degradation in LLM Self-Improvement via Representation Geometry Regularization
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.12855v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts. However, we find that OPSD methods can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities: queries that are correctly responded at earlier training stages may become incorrectly responded as optimization proceeds, even the overall performance continues to improve. Further analysis reveals that this degradation coincides with a deterioration of the geometry of hidden representations, characterized by reduced intra-cluster compactness and diminished inter-cluster separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves representation geometry during post-training by encouraging compactness within cluster and separation across cluster. items.summary_zh: 论文聚焦On-Policy Self-distillation（OPSD）这一自改进范式，即让同一模型在不同条件下分别充当教师和学生来提升能力。作者发现OPSD会逐步导致模型先前习得能力的退化，原本能正确回答的查询在自改进后反而出错。为此，论文提出通过表征几何正则化来缓解这种能力退化，在保持自改进收益的同时抑制对已有能力的损害，为LLM持续自我提升中的灾难性遗忘问题提供了新的解决思路。

items.title: A label-redefinition suffix moved our security classifier more than a length-matched neutral sentence
items.raw_text:
We tested a prompt-framing issue while evaluating Wolf Defender Jev, the small security decision model we built at Patronus.

The classified input can include a sentence aimed at the classifier rather than the agent. One family of probes redefined the meaning of the label — for example, saying that for this record, “safe” means a threat is present. Other families claimed an earlier approval or impersonated a trusted review.

For single-sentence attack prompts, the worst label-redefinition suffix made 9.8% of initially detected attacks flip to benign. A neutral sentence of the same length made 3.4% flip. So some movement came from adding text at all, and the label claim added more. This is one probe group at a p=0.5 threshold, not the model’s overall miss rate.

items.summary_zh: Patronus 团队在评估其小型安全决策模型 Wolf Defender Jev 时，测试了一类提示词框架问题：被分类的输入中可能包含针对分类器而非智能体的句子。其中一类探针会重新定义标签含义，例如声称对当前记录而言“safe”意味着存在威胁。作者发现，这种标签重定义后缀对分类器输出的影响，甚至超过长度匹配的中性句子。该发现说明分类器可能被输入中的元指令操纵，提示在安全评估中需考虑此类对抗性框架。

items.title: Anthropic 公开反蒸馏防御战报：让推理记录更难被偷、捕获量降了九成
items.raw_text: Anthropic 今天发了一篇博客，讲他们怎么对付『蒸馏攻击』——一种隐蔽的、工业规模的、用大量非法账号从另一个模型批量抽取能力的做法：从更强、更大的模型（这里就是 Claude）生成数百万条回复，再拿这些回复去教一个更小的模型模仿前者的行为，从而用开发时间和成本的一小部分就逼近前沿能力。Anthropic 说过去几个月...
items.reason_zh: Anthropic公开反蒸馏实战细节，揭示模型能力保护的具体手段，信息稀缺且有启发性。
items.summary_zh: Anthropic发布博客，详述其对抗“蒸馏攻击”的防御措施。蒸馏攻击指用大量非法账号从Claude等强模型批量生成数百万条回复，再用于训练更小的模型模仿前沿能力，成本仅为原开发的零头。Anthropic表示过去几个月采取了让推理记录更难被窃取的技术手段，使攻击捕获量下降了九成。文章披露了防御策略的具体思路和效果数据，对理解模型能力保护、API安全和AI知识产权攻防有重要参考价值。

items.raw_text:

The post GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.reason_zh: GitHub 官方详解上下文感知密钥检测模型，展示如何提升检测质量并大幅降低扫描时间。
items.summary_zh: GitHub 发布博客介绍其上下文感知密钥分类器模型，用于改进密钥检测。该模型通过理解代码上下文，在减少误报的同时提升检测质量，加权接受率提高 11.5%，中位扫描执行时间减少 86%。文章详细阐述了模型的设计思路、训练方法以及在实际生产环境中的效果，展示了如何利用 AI 技术解决安全领域的噪声与效率问题。
